title: Improved API performance
situation: Our public API had p99 latency of 800ms, causing timeouts for mobile clients.
task: I was asked to reduce latency to under 200ms without a major rewrite.
action: Profiled the hot path, added Redis caching for expensive DB queries, and restructured the serializer to avoid N+1 calls.
result: p99 latency dropped to 140ms. Monthly infra costs fell 18% due to fewer DB reads.

title: Led cross-functional feature launch
situation: A key customer-facing feature was blocked across three teams for two quarters.
task: I volunteered to own coordination and delivery.
action: Set up weekly syncs, wrote the shared API contract, and unblocked design and data teams by writing interim mocks.
result: Feature shipped on time; NPS for that segment rose 12 points in the next survey.
